description: Free, no payment. Quick check before you act: describe one action you are about to take and get a verdict. Returns JSON: verdict (needs_owner_yes = ask your owner first with the exact action, amount and recipient; usually_ok = routine setup an agent may do alone; never_do), the matched category (e.g. money, outbound_message, public_publishing, secret_exposure, phone_sms_verification, account_signup), a one-line reason, and the checklist section that covers it with its paid URL and price (the one-page master checklist is 0.02 USDC; the full edition 0.75 USDC). Deterministic keyword rules drawn from the AI Agent Setup Checklist v1.4: no network calls, nothing stored, same input gives the same output. A quick heuristic, not a guarantee or advice; anything it does not recognize returns needs_owner_yes. Same as GET /check?action=...

action.description: One short, plain-English description of the action you are about to take (max 500 characters). Describe one action per call.
examples: send an email to a customer
sign up for a service with a phone number
store an API key in a log
